Variants.Content: Salt Cliff Island is an offshore island in the Iron Islands, where steep cliffs, seabirds and salty winds are a more common sight than farmland. The arable land on the island is limited, and residents make a living by fishing, drying salt, herding sheep, repairing ships, and trading at sea. When storms block the waterway, storing salt and grain determines the life of a family more than trophies. The sea burials, prayers of the Drowned God, and longship traditions in Ironborn culture are closer to daily life here, because every trip to sea may become a farewell. Salt Cliff Island may seem isolated, but it is connected to Pike, Great Wick and the West Coast via the Island Chain Sea Route.

Entry Saltcliffe Local families also relied on salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and longships to return home; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Saltcliffe If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Saltcliffe A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Saltcliffe They care about salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and the return of longships. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
